content.value: Suppose receiver application program consumes data as 1byte at a time. For this, the receiver (06) TCP announces the window size as 1byte. So, the sending TCP sends 1byte at a time and the traffic intensity will be high. What has to be done to solve the problem? Explain two solutions.
